title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs
summary: Seekable OCI (SOCI) indexing for Amazon SageMaker AI training and processing jobs takes full container image download off the critical path. SageMaker AI lazy-loads your image to start containers in seconds instead of minutes, with no changes to your job definition. See the bench
reason: AWS announces a non-model product/infrastructure feature (SOCI-indexed container images) for SageMaker AI, linked to the company's official AWS blog announcement; no new model is named, so it is not a model release.
